_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Temporary Alteration (TEMPALT) Technical Data Package (TDP)
summary: Describes the format and content requirements for a Temporary Alteration (TEMPALT) Technical Data Package (TDP) documenting a ship's temporary alteration for Government review and approval.
use_relationship:
The Temporary Alteration (TEMPALT) Technical Data Package (TDP) provides the Government with documentation that describes the temporary alteration of the ship (including surface, submarine, unmanned vehicles, and other platforms). The TEMPALT TDP allows the Government to review design requirements that are applicable and appropriate for TEMPALTs and is intended to assure the ship's baseline characteristics are not compromised without proper consideration and approval.

This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated from the work task.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: NAVSEA S9070-AA-MME-010/SSN/SSBN, TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS MANUAL FOR TEMPORARY SUBMARINE ALTERATIONS

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TEMPALT TDP shall be in the format, in accordance to Reference Document (a).

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The TEMPALT TDP shall include the following, in accordance with Section 2.6 of Reference Document (a):

children.title: A copy of the Sponsor's request for TEMPALT installation authorization
children.content: a list of all platform(s) to which the TEMPALT is applicable, the TEMPALT type, the planned installation duration, any exceptions being requested for consideration, all forwarding letters/transmittals and the Government Point-of-Contact with desk and cell phone numbers and email address.

children.title: The TEMPALT TDP shall contain, or indicate that it is exempt from, the following
Appendix G - Shock Qualification Approval Letters
Appendix J - Other required calculations or references (e.g., Implodable/Explodable Volume Pressure Test Results)
Appendix K - Copies of other approval letters approval (e.g., Lithium Battery approval)
Appendix L - Conjunctive Temporary Engineering Change (TEC)
Appendix N - Supporting Documents (e.g., vendor specification sheets, Interface Control Drawings, Assembly Drawings)
Appendix O - Electromagnetic Interference (EMI)/ Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) Reports
